33/* @brief Stack equally formatted inputs along a new leading axis. Publish on any input update,
34 * holding the other inputs' latest values. The sample capture time is the newest input capture;
35 * per-input capture times remain available separately and are included in recording.
36 * The output retains the inputs' format kind, units and component axes. */
37class MOCHI_API SensorConcat final : public SensorBase {
38 public:
39 using Params = SensorConcatParams;
40
41 static constexpr std::string_view TypeName() {
42 return "SENSOR_CONCAT";
43 }
44
45 SensorConcat(Actor* actor, std::string_view paramArgs, superdex::Error& error);
46 explicit SensorConcat(Params const& params, superdex::Error& error);
47
48 [[nodiscard]] std::string_view GetTypeName() const override {
49 return TypeName();
50 }
51
52 [[nodiscard]] SensorStepResult Step(StepTime const& now, superdex::Error& error) override;
53
54 [[nodiscard]] double GetPublicationFrequencyHzEstimate() const override;
55
56 void ConfigureRecording(SensorRecordingSink& sink, superdex::Error& error) const override;
57 void Record(SensorRecordingSink& sink, superdex::Error& error) const override;
58
59 [[nodiscard]] Params const& GetParams() const {
60 return _params;
61 }
62
63 [[nodiscard]] Span<double const> GetInputCaptureTimes() const {
64 return _inputCaptureTimes;
65 }
66
67 [[nodiscard]] Span<int64_t const> GetInputCaptureSteps() const {
68 return _inputCaptureSteps;
69 }
70
71 private:
72 [[nodiscard]] SensorFormat InitSensor(SensorScope const& scope, superdex::Error& error) override;
73 void ResetSensor() override;
74
75 Params _params;
76 DynamicArray<float> _values;
77 DynamicArray<int64_t> _inputPublishedSteps;
78 DynamicArray<int64_t> _inputCaptureSteps;
79 DynamicArray<double> _inputCaptureTimes;
80};
